data.summary: Once this model has fired in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), choose an enemy unit struck by at least one of its attacks. Until the phase ends, friendly TYRANIDS models re-roll [Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1 when attacking it.
